families.name: Offensive-line injuries
families.spec_direction_text: QB down slightly; RB efficiency down; checkdown/target share to RB up slightly (pressure outlet); team pass rate down a tick.
families.spec_trigger: starting LT (or C) ruled out/doubtful; backup starting

affected.note: spec: that DST's projection (target renamed to keep the emission fence: no 'projection' key in records)

families.name: Defensive secondary injuries
families.spec_direction_text: opposing pass game up; that defense down; opposing offense implied total up slightly.

trigger.boundary_note: The spec's trigger word is 'out'. DOUBTFUL / QUESTIONABLE designations do NOT fire this family in v1 (deliberate boundary; the Riley Moss case in the worked instance is the standing example).

families.name: Pass-rush injuries
families.spec_direction_text: starting EDGE out -> opposing QB time-to-throw up -> QB/WR up slightly. Mirror of rule 2 for the front seven.

trigger.boundary_note: Spec names EDGE only. Off-ball LB absences and 4-3 DE naming are not addressed by the spec (SPEC_GAP); they do not fire this family in v1.

families.mapping_note: The event vocabulary includes 'consolidation' for the authored case where an absence consolidates share onto the incumbent starter (the spec's own worked shape: a backfield consolidating to the lead back). Elevation/snap_jump/bellcow are the spec's literal trigger words.
families.name: Skill-position depth chart movement
families.spec_direction_text: AFFECTED: that player's volume projection; teammates' target share down.
families.spec_trigger: RB/WR/TE elevated to starter, snap share jumps, or bellcow tags

affected.note: Direction implied by the wind context; the spec lists kick distance as affected without stating its direction (minor SPEC_GAP, recorded).

families.name: Weather
families.spec_direction_text: AFFECTED: pass yards/attempts down, kick distance, run rate up.
families.spec_trigger: sustained wind thresholds, precipitation, extreme cold

trigger.precip_subtrigger: UNARMED — neither the spec nor the registry states a precipitation threshold; precipitation alone never fires this family in v1 (SPEC_GAP).

thresholds.provenance: Threshold numbers are NOT in the spec (SPEC_GAP). They are the fleet's own formalized values from the situational-graph edge registry (edge_types.json, weather_extreme thresholds: wind_mph 20, temp_low_f 20, temp_high_f 95), reused so the two layers agree.

affected.note: Spec: garbage-time discount applies — 4th-quarter trailing volume is NOT role change. Both flags ride on every record this target emits.

families.name: Game script / Vegas
families.spec_direction_text: trailing-team pass volume up (garbage-time discount applies), leading-team run rate up.

thresholds.provenance: The spec says 'large spreads' without a number (SPEC_GAP). 7.0 is the fleet's existing encode (apps/web/lib/signals/adjustment-layer.ts, spec rule 6 shadow module: |spread| >= 7), reused as a named parameter, not a spec value.

trigger.totals_subtrigger: UNARMED — no high/low totals threshold exists in the spec or in any fleet encode found; totals alone never fire this family in v1 (SPEC_GAP).

affected.note: VARIANCE = friction/variance effect, explicitly NOT a mean shift. Band UNSPECIFIED: rule 7 carries no magnitude language at all (SPEC_GAP).

families.name: Off-field signals (intake lane)
families.spec_direction_text: (none in spec — see direction_source per subtrigger)
families.spec_trigger: Intake starts with what's measurable (injury report participation, travel distance, rest days) before anything exotic. Nutrition, sleep/travel, psychology, cognitive load: no ingestion exists.

subtriggers.direction_source: The spec states NO direction for rule 7. The VARIANCE (friction, not mean shift) direction is taken from the fleet's authored Layer-2 read of this exact composite (Grok WO-0 read, SEA@DEN, 2026-10-15) and is cited in each record's evidence. It is not a spec value.
subtriggers.input: graph edge type altitude_short_week (composite: visitor at >= 4,000 ft on <= 5 days rest; thresholds from the graph edge registry)

subtriggers.direction_source: VARIANCE against the shorter-rest team; same citation class as above. Any nonzero differential fires (no band exists in the spec — SPEC_GAP).
subtriggers.input: graph edge type rest_differential with rest_diff_home_minus_away != 0

subtriggers.direction_source: VARIANCE against the traveling team; fires only when such a stamped row is supplied. No distance input exists for the worked instance, so this lane honestly does not fire there.
subtriggers.input: stamped template row of kind 'travel' carrying distance for the visiting team

trigger.unmeasurable_lanes: Nutrition / psychology / cognitive load have NO ingestion anywhere (the spec says so itself) and no triggers in v1. Sleep is carried only through the rest-days measurable. (SPEC_GAP — intake lane, benchmark program, build-order step 5.)

magnitude_doctrine: The spec fixes the SHAPE; backtests fix the numbers. Every record therefore carries a qualitative magnitude BAND taken from the spec's own words (slightly / a tick / unqualified), magnitude: null, calibrated: false. No numeric magnitude is invented anywhere in this package.
